description.value:
Your eidolon shares some strange bit of lore that distracts the target's mind. Your eidolon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recalls Knowledge} on the target and the target must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC. The target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to its Will DC against this effect if your eidolon succeeded its Recall Knowledge check (-2 on a critical success).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is off-guard and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to Perception and Will saves for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.summons-unleashed.Item.ESDK9v26NhkL31VV]{Effect: Befuddling Knowledge (Success)}).

Failure As success except the circumstance penalty is -3 and it doesn't end automatically. The target can end the effect early by succeeding a Recall Knowledge check against your spell DC (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.summons-unleashed.Item.akAhbRjgwBfoBYIJ]{Effect: Befuddling Knowledge (Failure)}).

Critical Failure As failure except the target is also stunned 1 as it processes new information.
